controls.seed: Fixes authored irregularities for repeatable rebuilds.
controls.face_size_px: Near-view surface resolution; all maps are power-of-two PNGs.
controls.tile_metres: Physical width U and length V of one repeat; fine pieces crop at the same density.
controls.rings: Annual growth bands across the sawn face.
controls.warp: Deviation from straight growth: restrained pine, stronger resinheart.
controls.knots: Closed dark knot centres per face; no holes.
controls.relief_m: Normal-only fine relief in metres; no collision change or magical scars.
controls.roughness: Dry versus burnished response; never emission.
controls.courses/stakes: Horizontal reed courses / vertical supports per 0.4 m tile.
controls.pores: Coarse closed cork pores per 0.3 m tile.

families.name: Timber
families.purpose: Warm broad growth, torn fibres and irregular transverse tool chatter.

families.name: Pine
families.purpose: Pale long grain, small dark knots and lighter end grain.

families.name: Bog oak
families.purpose: Dense nearly black brown grain with water-dark elongated pores.

families.name: Ash wood
families.purpose: Silvered bone-pale fibres retaining warm wood beneath weathering.

families.name: Resinheart
families.purpose: Strong amber growth, dense end rings and non-emissive resin pockets.

families.name: Woven reed
families.purpose: Alternating over-under bundles with opaque dark backing and bundled cut edges.

families.name: Corkbark
families.purpose: Irregular coarse closed pores and stratified cut edges.
